post.summary: Deprecated: ask the assistant with browser-supplied history
post.description: Deprecated compatibility route; use the conversation API. Removal checkpoint: Checkpoint C (the frontend moves to /assistant/conversations). Each call is a recorded turn in a new server-owned conversation that uses only the final user message: earlier messages in the body are validated but never sent to the model. Responses carry Deprecation and Link headers.

200.description: The answer, tool calls, cards, and limitations.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: invalid conversation.

503.description: ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE: no model configured, model timeout, or provider error. Other routes are unaffected.

post.summary: Start a conversation owned by the caller
post.description: Not idempotent and takes no Idempotency-Key. Send the first message with the message endpoint. A conversation whose first message never arrived stays listed with messageCount 0; retention removes empty conversations 30 days after creation.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR

503.description: ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE: conversation storage is unavailable. Other routes are unaffected.

get.summary: One owned conversation: ordered messages and turn states
get.description: Returns every saved message and turn (not paginated). A saved answer whose recorded actor scope the caller's current scope no longer covers is withheld (withheld: true, fixed text, response null); the user message stays visible.

200.description: Messages in sequence order. A failed turn has a user message and a safe error, never an assistant answer.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: unknown and unowned conversations return the same body.

503.description: ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE: conversation storage is unavailable. Other routes are unaffected.

post.summary: Send one user message and run a recorded assistant turn
post.description: The server loads bounded history: at most the 4 most recent COMPLETED turns (user message plus final answer), at most 16,000 characters, newest first, stopping at the first turn that does not fit. Failed and in-progress turns, the retried turn, and tool data from earlier turns are never sent. Every model and tool step is recorded before and after it runs; the answer is returned only after the assistant message and trace are saved. On a 502 or 503 the response has no trace ID; when a trace was created it appears in the conversation detail as a FAILED turn with the same code and reason. Counts toward the limit of 20 assistant requests per HR user per 15 minutes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Generated by the client per submission; a UUID v4 (36 characters) fits. Reuse only to retry the same submission: the same key and command returns the stored result (Idempotency-Replayed: true), or 409 ASSISTANT_TURN_IN_PROGRESS while it is still running. A user-selected Retry sends a new key with retryOfTraceId.

200.description: The recorded answer, tool statuses, cards, and limitations.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED, invalid message, or retryOfTraceId outside the conversation).

404.description: NOT_FOUND: unknown and unowned conversations return the same body.

409.description: DUPLICATE_OPERATION (key reused with different content) or ASSISTANT_TURN_IN_PROGRESS.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: more than 20 assistant message requests by this HR user in 15 minutes.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current 15-minute window resets.

RateLimit.description: IETF draft-8 RateLimit header: remaining requests (r) and seconds to reset (t).

RateLimit-Policy.description: IETF draft-8 policy: limit (q) and window seconds (w).

502.description: MODEL_PROVIDER_FAILED, reason MODEL_TIMEOUT, MODEL_RATE_LIMITED, MODEL_ERROR, or MODEL_INVALID_RESPONSE. The failed turn is recorded.

503.description: ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE, reason MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED (the message and a FAILED turn are recorded; no model call), TRACE_UNAVAILABLE (required recording failed; nothing unrecorded ran), or TURN_TIMEOUT.

post.summary: Admin HR: regenerate a temporary password
post.description: Account recovery, for example after a lost creation response. Stores only the Argon2id hash of a new random password, revokes every active session, increments the version, and writes one TEMPORARY_PASSWORD_REGENERATED audit event in one transaction, then returns the password once. No email is sent. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key does not regenerate again: it returns temporaryPassword null and credentialRecoveryRequired true. An Admin cannot regenerate their own password (another active Admin must do it).
